label: Pro Sports Teams & Performance
heroHeading: A whole squad through recovery, between sessions
seoDescription: Professional athlete recovery systems — HBOT, contrast therapy & red light. Data-driven protocols for team performance centers.

valueProps.title: Group-sized, not one at a time
valueProps.body: An eight-person cold room and a large cabin get a squad through in minutes, instead of queueing for a single tub.

valueProps.title: One supplier for all four
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric, cold, heat and light from the same manufacturer. One contract, one install team, one app and one number to call when something needs attention.

valueProps.title: Built to run all day
valueProps.body: Built for daily use through a season, home and away, with local parts and technicians in North America and Australia.

valueProps.title: Under your medical staff
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric and everything else runs to your doctors’ and physios’ programme, per athlete, logged in the app.

features.title: Fits the training week
features.body: Cold after sessions and games, heat on rest days, light between sessions. We plan the room so recovery happens on the way out, not as a separate trip.

features.title: No ice, no hoses, no water tests
features.body: A dry cold room means no filling, draining or bags of ice for your staff, and no water chemistry log for your facility team.
